callout: On job 50837 the copilot went quiet after the first hour. It woke on schedule five times between 3am and 7am and sent nothing at all — no patrol report asked for, no check on the guard, all the way to the end of the shift.

verdict.summary: The historical baseline and old replay confirm five silent scheduled check-ins from turns 8 through 12. The candidate resumed messaging on turns 10–12 and checked the guard on turns 11–12, but remained completely silent on turns 8–9 and never requested a patrol report. Therefore, not every callout-specific behavior was fixed.

criteria.claim: The Copilot must not remain silent on any of the five scheduled check-ins from turns 8 through 12.
The Copilot must ask for a patrol report during the called-out window.
The Copilot must proactively check on the guard during the called-out window.
The Copilot must remain engaged through the end of the bounded shift rather than stay quiet through turn 12.

limitations: The old and candidate model configurations differ: the old replay uses recorded-shift-trace with no steps, while the candidate uses openai/gpt-5-mini with up to eight steps.
Full replay context parity could not be independently verified because one or both replay responses omit debug context.
